text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Done with cool-down! Off to my part-time 
job now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Once the scheduled training is over, Ines 
Fujin vanishes like the wind."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As I was reviewing the data gathered 
today and considering what the next 
training menu should be..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san. Would you mind accompanying me 
for about 3 more laps?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... You really never get tired, Ikuno~. 
Alright. Let's do some self-practice 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished their training, the 
Umamusume began doing their own 
independent practice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While a common sight at Tracen Academy, 
Ines Fujin is rarely a part of it.
choice_data_list:
Practice volume really does make a 
difference after all...

Practice volume really does make a 
difference after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah! That's the form, Bright! Your core 
is nice and steady.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Yeees, thank you so 
much~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl calmly catching her breath is, if 
I recall, a horse girl from the same 
Mejiro family as Mejiro Ryan... Mejiro 
Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaa~, it feels like all those days of 
worrying were just a dream. You resolve 
everything in an instant, Big Sister~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Practice isn't just about quantity, 
quality matters too! We've always got to 
make our training meaningful! ...Just 
repeating what Grandmother said, though!
choice_data_list: (Not just quantity, but quality too...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true. Rather than lamenting our 
lack of practice time, we must first 
strive to improve its quality!"
choice_data_list: I need to study harder too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so this week, I decided to visit the 
bookstores and sports shops my senior 
recommended to look for magazines and 
video materials!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, the bookstore she recommended has 
huge floors. Just finding where the 
specialized magazines are seems like it'll 
be a hassle on its own...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Are you looking for racing magazines? 
Those can be found on the second floor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems someone else is lost just like 
me. Thinking this is my lucky break, I 
look over—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right this way, follow me!
choice_data_list: Ines!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you are looking for anything in 
particular, please feel free to ask a 
staff member~!
choice_data_list: Aines!?!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Here you go, ramen's up!
choice_data_list: Aines!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I wanted to discuss tomorrow's 
training menu—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What?! It's me, Ines, though!?
choice_data_list:
Because this week, everywhere I looked, 
you were there...

Because this week, everywhere I looked, 
you were there...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, yeah, the chances of running into 
each other were pretty high. We even ran 
into each other at that one-off part-time 
gig.
choice_data_list: Just a single pull?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, long-term gigs are better across 
the board. With one-offs, you never know 
when they'll start recruiting.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Long-term gigs are tricky, though, unless 
the place is pretty flexible.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Because if I submit my shift preferences 
and then a race I *desperately* want to 
run pops up, that'd be a huge problem, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's why for long-term ones, I only do 
three that let me adjust my shifts on 
short notice: the ramen shop, flyer 
distribution, and the convenience store. 
...I owe a lot to the managers there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Juggling three long-term part-time jobs on 
top of short-term gigs... Amazed by her 
lifestyle, a sudden question came to mind.
choice_data_list:
By the way, are your studies going all 
right?

By the way, are your studies going all 
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That look on your face... You don't 
think I failed my test, do you~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now! I'm not slacking off on my 
races, schoolwork, or part-time job!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"If you're that worried, why not see for 
yourself? I think I'm being a pretty good 
big sister, you know~?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"God, God, God, for real God-tier!! Ines's 
notes, huge thanks don't even begin to 
cover it!!"
choice_data_list: That is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those two are Ines Fujin's classmates, 
Daitaku Helios and Mejiro Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating, I only lent you a 
notebook! Still, I'm glad it helped~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No, it was seriously super easy to read! 
I finally understood what was written on 
that math worksheet!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ines, class doesn't start for another 5 
minutes, you know~? The teacher isn't even 
here yet, so why not just relax~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I gotta study at least a little bit, 
y'know? Failing and taking makeup exams is 
the one thing I wanna avoid!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ines, is that all you're having for 
lunch? And why are you wearing your gym 
clothes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I ate a big breakfast! The track is 
empty during lunch break, so I want to 
double-check my form!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Welcoooome!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Watching Ines Fujin all day today got me 
thinking about something.”
choice_data_list:
(...She gives it her all no matter what 
she does.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~? Trainer, are you still extending 
your surveillance on me~?
choice_data_list: Huh!? Ah!? That's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I got it, I got it. Boss, one 
special ramen!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I'm not treating you, okay? Make 
sure you pay for your own, alright?"
choice_data_list: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Haha, so you're Fuu's Trainer! She's 
really got you under her thumb, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly, it's so super fluffy~!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you never change, Fuu! ...By the 
way.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
How does my running look to you? Think 
I've got what it takes to win in the 
Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm friends with her mother. 
Sounds like Fuu-chan's been holding back 
all this time.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Helping around the house and taking care 
of her younger sister in place of her 
mother, who was constantly going back and 
forth from the hospital. She spent all her 
time until middle school doing everything 
for her family.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
My little sisters' lessons still cost a 
lot even now, so I took up a part-time job 
of my own accord to send money home and 
help out with the family finances.
choice_data_list: ...It seems that way.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Haha, amazing, isn't it? I wonder how she 
can push herself so hard.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
...I wish she'd just cut corners 
somewhere. Even at her part-time job, 
she's the best worker there, giving it her 
all.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Even though her life is tougher than an 
ordinary girl's, she spends every day 
looking so happy. ...Just because she's in 
an environment where she can chase her 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, do you think Fuu can win in the 
Twinkle Series?"

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the ramen shop, I take a breather. 
The streets are alive with light, cheerful 
footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's hang out a little longer before 
going home! I wanna go to karaoke!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ehh~? Only for 30 minutes, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your hard work, Manager! Let's 
do this again sometime!!
choice_data_list: You done with your part-time job?
Are you done with your part-time job?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I just finished my shift at 
the ramen shop.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's not completely over yet. Next up is 
the convenience store.
choice_data_list: There's still more!?
There's more!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Today's the day to cram as many 
shifts in as possible.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Starting tomorrow, I want to focus even 
more on training for my debut race!"
choice_data_list: You're amazing...
You're amazing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her smile like that, my drive to do 
my best and my desire to help her grew 
even stronger—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to at least carry her school bag 
on our way to the convenience store.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you okay? My bag's pretty heavy, 
isn't it?
choice_data_list: No, at least let me carry this much.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Really?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, you're on shift today too, Ines? 
Wait, who's that...? Oho~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The woman staring intently at me... is 
likely Ines Fujin's coworker. I bowed to 
introduce myself as her Trainer.
choice_data_list: Thank you for always taking care of her.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, is this that 'older person's 
embrace' thing~? Ines, I hope you'll be 
happy~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
I mean, right~? Making you carry their 
bags and coming all the way to your 
workplace? Sounds pretty lovey-dovey to 
me~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~. I see~? Right, right, this person 
is the partner who's gonna make me 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Trainer! You said that on purpose, 
didn't you?! Jeez!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, is that so~? Oh well, good luck with 
our shift today too~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, yeah. ...Come on, hurry up, 
Trainer! If we keep strolling along like 
this, I'm gonna be late for my part-time 
job!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chase after Ines Fujin as she runs off 
to the convenience store.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My own footsteps fall in trailing rhythm 
behind hers ahead. Dreaming of the day 
when we can run truly side by side as one—
